purpose: Prove a lightweight Meaning Graph that links Council objects for explanation only — never for workflow authority. Graph Entities cover two Work Items, two Source Records, a person, a role, a project, and a topic (Work Item / Source Record / receipt bindings resolve to sibling Story 1.x slices; net-new person/role/project/topic entities use fresh GE-LOCAL-* identity). Graph Edges (GEDGE-LOCAL-*) link them with vocabulary-valid edge types, rationale, confidence in [0,1], source/receipt grounding refs, and a declared retained-value tag. An explicit authority guard states edgesOwnNoWorkflowState=true and a demonstration entry proves a Work Item state group is identical before and after edge creation, with no state field on any edge.

The Council Publisher role that carries solution publisher responsibility for the Council of Minions MVP solution.

graphEdges.com_rationale: CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-001 was extracted from the manual meeting-note Source Record; this edge records the extraction provenance for explanation only and does not restate the source's extraction rationale.
The Fabric-ontology-deferral decision CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-002 is evidenced by the same meeting-note source; the edge is an explanation link, not a workflow dependency.
The decision concerns the tenant readiness checklist topic, providing retrieval context for the explanation surface.
The Council of Minions MVP project materially involves Doug, who captured the meeting note and owns the pending publisher-prefix decision.
The Council Publisher role is assigned to Doug, supporting routing of publisher-prefix approval work toward the right human.
The follow-up Work Item CWI-LOCAL-FOLLOWUP-001 was extracted from the mock Outlook message source; this edge records extraction provenance for explanation and does not govern the Work Item's state.
The Council of Minions MVP project is about the tenant readiness checklist topic, supporting audit lineage from project to topic to source.

authorityGuard.guardStatement: Meaning Graph edges carry no workflow state. No edge holds a com_state_group, com_work_item_state, status, state, or any field that would make the graph the workflow authority. Work Item state lives only on the Work Item and moves only through receipts gated to Epic 2.

demonstration.note: CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-001 is bound to graph entity GE-LOCAL-DECISION-001 and is touched by edges GEDGE-LOCAL-001 (com_from_entity=GE-LOCAL-DECISION-001) and GEDGE-LOCAL-003 (com_from_entity=GE-LOCAL-DECISION-001). Neither edge carries a state field. The Work Item's com_state_group is proposed in the sibling Story 1.3 proposedWorkItems array (the structured harvest target); beforeStateGroup and afterStateGroup both equal that harvested value, so the state group is identical before and after edge creation. The graph records explanation links only.

Every retained-value tag in the closed set is exercised by at least one edge (provenance, retrieval, context, routing, explanation, audit).
